- human (Kalashar), way of astral self monk.
- Appearance: (first draft -likely how he looked when they first went to the factory, their much more rough looking-) >
- Opalescent white eyes
- Light brown hair
- White skin
- Bags under eyes
- Basic factory uniform
- Metal appendage off of the back (attached by spikes that pierce their skin and closely stays near the spine, sending and receiving signals from the nearby nerves.)
 

Backstory:

Born in the ‘Slums’, Voodle was the oldest child of Arnald and Felicity Arkin. From a young age, Voodle didn’t dream like most people, they just thought the same thoughts they did when they were awake and those thoughts… were incredible. Surly unachievable but incredible. It was these ‘thoughts’ that made them unique… Different. 

As they grew up, they isolated themselves to their room, noting their ideas of biomechanical enhancements and learning anything they could about machinery (which at the time was very little). They were heavily bullied whenever they went outside due to their ‘scrawlings’, this led to them getting into fights and becoming disconnected from people even more. Resulting in a residual mistrust of people. 

Their isolation became worse and worse, especially after their Father grew ill. Their family had less and less money and no one knew how to earn more. Voodle was eventually urged to get a job and help pay for their fathers diagnosis. This led them to going from job to job just trying to help. But it never really helped, they barely made any money and rarely kept a job for more than a month. That is until they volunteered to help in the construction of Modrons, which let their family get some money but disconnected them from their family entirely.

They thrived in the factory, studying the mechanisms and silently figuring out the easiest way to optimize it. Eventually figuring out the parts that were unnecessary and discreetly taking them for themselves, and tinkering on them in an out of the way space. This project would be their first cybernetic attachment, their third arm.

In little to no time, they were figured out and reported to someone higher up who contacted someone called Nathaniel Mondrey Cole. Nathaniel was polite in his scolding of Voodle (telling them their actions were wrong and threatening disciplinary action if their actions continued). After this Nathaniel had a weird proposition of  Voodle, “I’ll give you the supplies you need, if you allow me to help you create this.” It was cut and dry. Exactly what Voodle needed… Support. So they had to say,

“Wait what… Didn’t you say, what I did was wrong?”

“I did and it was, but that was all what I was asked to do. This is my own interest speaking.”

“Well… I guess that makes sense. I suppose I’d have to agree… Right?”

“It would be the most beneficial choice towards your project. Especially if you want free use of  your product.”

“Then, I accept!”

  

Voodle then began working alongside Nathaniel, or Noodle as they now called him. It was still mainly Voodle that did the work and development, but Noodle would add his input and supply any needed materials. It seemed completely beneficial, but then it came to testing. Obviously, Voodle wanted to keep the project private and so they opted to be the first test subject (also the arm was made to Voodles build, so it made the most sense). Noodle agreed and opened a private testing chamber for Voodle to use. He helped Voodle attach the appendage (and helped clear up the blood) and recorded the results, which were incredibly successful with Voodle being able to manipulate the prototype with ease. This led to Voodle keeping the attachment, only taking it off periodically to make alterations (which allowed them to utilise it somewhat as a weapon and more as an additional limb in their scrappy fighting style).

Things were going smoothly, and Voodle was gaining more confidence and even decided to make a 2nd more improved model. Suddenly a letter came to Noodle and Voodle’s home, regarding Voodle's father and his funeral. Voodle was shocked by his death but quickly moved past it, wanting to throw themselves back into their work. Nathaniel pushed them to go and see their father off, to which Voodle hesitantly accepted. 

The funeral was… quaint. Quiet, quaint and strangely felt normal to them. Their uncomfortable, abnormal normal. Something was obviously wrong. Even now Voodle doesn’t know what it was wrong, but it just didn't feel right, just Voodle’s normal.

When getting home, Voodle immediately went to the testing chamber, wanting to work off the paranoia they’d accrued. Upon getting there;

*Door opens*

Voodle walks into the lab, moving quickly over to their work station. Only to find the new arm missing. Panic sunk in. Their heart raced. Their work was gone.

They rushed around the lab, looking for some hint of where it went. The plain walls suffocated them. Their thoughts were getting too loud…

“-Voodle?” A strained voice in the silence, it sounded like it was in the same room. But No-one was there. “-help..me…” Immeasurable fear riddled Voodle as Noodle's weak voice invaded their mind. They rushed to the training room. Blood leaked from the back of Nathaniel and the muscles ,surrounding the spikes of the arm, spasmed and convulsed, being shocked by the arm. He was completely unconscious. Voodle panicked, tearing the arm from Noodle’s back and using their V1 arm to help bring him upstairs. 

“Help! Please-” Their voice was weak, but the entire house stirred in response. Almost like their voice was heard everywhere.

The servants were quick to help and Nathaniel’s wounds were cleaned. Voodle was having a breakdown, tears streamed down their face, they were short of breath. They tried to find something to focus on;

“So much for being uncaring-” A new voice entered the array of noise. A stranger, one that was judging Voodle. Their eyes met. Someone who looked almost identical to Nathan- Noodle. Someone who scoffed at Noodle's pain. Someone who mocked them.

The events that followed were a rush. Voodle was ensured safety, even after the stranger made an accusation against them. And Voodle was listened to as they expressed that Noodle wouldn’t have been able to attach the arm alone, a full investigation took place and Voodle had to be moved into a private estate with Nathaniel. During this time, Voodle figured out their psi-kick ability. Communicating to Nathan even while he was comatosed, apparently they had ‘thought outloud’ often while working on their project. They bonded a lot during this time, but Noodle never shared why he tried to wear the arm but Voodle had a vague idea. It was the stranger. He must have done something. He endangered Noodle. He was trying to steal or test Voodle’s work. Voodle had to keep Noodle safe. They had to leave.

  

So they did 

(this bit I haven’t fully written, but I think could lead well into the campaign)

  

OOC STUFF:

- Arnard was a Kalashar, but was unaware of his abilities and how to use them. This illness he suffered from was due to this inability, as such it was also experienced by all other members of their lineage who didn’t realise they had these abilities. (all of them)
    
- Voodle did appear in public a couple of times alongside Nathan (and yes they did call him ‘Noodle’)
    
- Voodle’s project was never made public, but Noodle did announce he was working on something.
    
- -May change as I alter their design- Voodle’s eyes are the most obvious inhuman feature they have, with their ability to use the appendage being a close second (the shear mental capacity needed for your brain to not only process the nerve inputs of a new limb, but also freely use said limb must be almost impossible, hence only a Kalashar or other psi-kickly gifted individuals would have the mental fortitude to do so)
    
- Due to the continued use of the arm, Voodle has developed pits on their back that no longer bleed. Due to this the arm used to fall out, so they have since added metal holders to their back, to prevent the arm from falling out
    
- Voodle does experience something similar to ‘phantom limb’ when they aren't wearing the arm
    
- Voodle is gender queer and hasn’t defined what their attracted to, not cause they’re aro-ace but just cause they don’t know at the moment
    
- Nathaniel is apart of ‘the Top Layer’ and did originally have the intent of using Voodle, but after he went into his coma his views changed and he now genuinely cares for Voodle
    
- Voodle has a very inhuman outlook on life, acting childishly positive when in reality they constantly think things are going to go wrong or the worst will happen soon. This was only enforced by Noodle’s coma.
    
- Since being comatoast, Nathaniel has learned to fully control his thoughts due to his conversations with Voodle 
    
- I thought that their limb could act as their ‘astral self’ so as they level up they just gain more and more bionic limbs/attributes.
    
- Feel free to come up with how the Kalashar are within this universe because I’m not 100% sure if their current lore fits in this setting?
